title: Sharp lower bound for the Monge-Ampère torsion on convex sets
summary: The \emph{Monge-Ampère} torsion deficit of an open, bounded convex set $Ω\subset\R^n$ of class $C^2$ is the normalized gap between the value of the torsion functional evaluated on $Ω$ and its value on the ball with the same $(n-1)$-quermassintegral as $Ω$.
